clos.original_description: Learners should be able to use common techniques to retrieve data from multiple data sources: SQL, NoSQL databases, APIs, Cloud
clos.enriched_description: Learners should be able to use common techniques to retrieve data from multiple data sources: SQL, NoSQL databases, APIs, Cloud. The scope includes Retrieving and Cleaning data and Cleaning data.

clos.original_description: Learners should be able to describe and use common feature selection and feature engineering techniques
clos.enriched_description: Learners should be able to describe and use common feature selection and feature engineering techniques. The scope includes Exploratory Data Analysis and Feature Engineering and Feature Engineering and Variable.

clos.original_description: Learners should be able to use a variety of techniques for detecting and dealing with outliers
clos.enriched_description: Learners should be able to use a variety of techniques for detecting and dealing with outliers. The scope includes Inferential Statistics and Hypothesis Testing, Estimation and Inference, Hypothesis Testing (Homework), and Demo Lab Feature Engineering.

clos.original_description: Learners should be able to describe and use supervised models
clos.enriched_description: Learners should be able to describe and use supervised models. The scope includes Introduction to Supervised Machine Learning and Linear Regression and Introduction to Supervised Machine Learning.

clos.original_description: Learners should be able to use a variety of error metrics to compare and select a supervised model that best suits your data
clos.enriched_description: Learners should be able to use a variety of error metrics to compare and select a supervised model that best suits your data. The scope includes Logistic Regression: Introduction to Classification and Error Metrics, Error Metrics, and Model Interpretability (Homework).

clos.original_description: Learners should be able to use oversampling and undersampling as techniques to handle unbalanced classes in a data
clos.enriched_description: Learners should be able to use oversampling and undersampling as techniques to handle unbalanced classes in a data. The scope includes Modeling Unbalanced Classes and Practice Lab: Modeling Imbalanced Classes.

clos.original_description: Learners should be able to explain the kinds of problems suitable for Unsupervised Learning approaches
clos.enriched_description: Learners should be able to explain the kinds of problems suitable for Unsupervised Learning approaches. The scope includes Introduction to Unsupervised Learning and K Means and Introduction to Unsupervised Learning.

clos.original_description: Explain the curse of dimensionality, and how it makes clustering difficult with many features
clos.enriched_description: Explain the curse of dimensionality, and how it makes clustering difficult with many features. The scope includes K Means Clustering, Selecting a clustering algorithm, Distance Metrics of Clustering Algorithms, Common clustering algorithms, Hierarchical Agglomerative Clustering, Hierarchical Agglomerative Clustering Lab, Compare clustering algorithms, Clustering Demo, and Dimensionality Reduction.

clos.original_description: Learners should be able to describe and use common clustering and dimensionality-reduction algorithms
clos.enriched_description: Learners should be able to describe and use common clustering and dimensionality-reduction algorithms. The scope includes Selecting a clustering algorithm, Distance Metrics of Clustering Algorithms, Common clustering algorithms, Hierarchical Agglomerative Clustering, Hierarchical Agglomerative Clustering Lab, Compare clustering algorithms, and Clustering Demo.

clos.original_description: Implement a mini capstone ML project includes steps: data collection, data wrangling, exploratory data analysis, model development, model evaluation, and reporting
clos.enriched_description: Implement a mini capstone ML project includes steps: data collection, data wrangling, exploratory data analysis, model development, model evaluation, and reporting. The scope includes Guiding mini Capstone, Review the mini Capstone, and Review mini Capstone.
